# LRC Studio

> LRC Studio is a free, browser-based lyric synchronization tool. Upload an audio file or paste a YouTube link, add lyrics, and create timestamped .lrc or .srt files in minutes. No installation, and you can start without signing up.

## Features

- Real-time line sync: tap Space to stamp each lyric line while the track plays, and nudge timestamps with the arrow keys.
- Word-level timing: karaoke-style highlighting, with Japanese furigana support and singer tagging for duets.
- Lyrics search: search, preview and import lyrics from the song title and artist.
- Export: standard .lrc, word-level enhanced .lrc, and .srt subtitles.
- Accounts: save projects to a personal library, sync across devices, and share projects by link.
